columns.description: The RETURN items, by alias or by their text.

values.description: One value a column. A node is { id, kind, name, path, line, key } (an external symbol { id, kind: external, name, module }); a relationship { id, type, from, to, from_name, to_name, path, line, basis }, at its site; a path { nodes, relationships }; otherwise a scalar or a list.

inferred.description: True when any relationship the row was matched through is inferred.
